summary: Post-refactor backend split (9446-line monolith -> core.py + models.py + 11 route modules). Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_refactor_smoke.py covering every endpoint family in the review request: public, auth (login/signup/verify/forgot/reset/me/sessions/revoke/logout), CSRF middleware, security headers, profile + resume upload, jobs/search streaming, greenhouse, saved-jobs, applications CRUD, dashboard/stats, admin/ats-stats, admin RBAC gate, extension/autofill, screening-questions, stripe/subscription, stripe/checkout, AI (optimize-resume/cover-letter/interview-prep/detailed-match-analysis). 26/27 pytest cases pass (96%). Routing, model wiring, scheduler, CORS, OAuth-only paths, and security headers are all preserved by the refactor.

critical.issue: CSRF bypass: when an authenticated request (session_token cookie present) sends a state-changing PUT/POST/DELETE WITHOUT an X-CSRF-Token header, the middleware silently allows the request. Manually verified: PUT /api/profile with session+csrf cookies but no X-CSRF-Token header returns 200; with WRONG header returns 403; with correct header returns 200. Logic flaw: `if not csrf_header and not csrf_cookie: pass` falls through to next() because csrf_cookie is always set after login. Spec in review explicitly requires 403 for missing header on authenticated requests. This is a pre-existing bug copied from the monolith but materially weakens CSRF protection.

rca of the issue: CSRF bypass RCA: in /app/backend/server.py:208-231 the middleware reads csrf_header and csrf_cookie. The branching `if not csrf_header and not csrf_cookie: pass / elif csrf_header: <validate>` has no `else` — so the case where csrf_cookie is set but csrf_header is empty (the exact CSRF attack vector) falls through unprotected. After the login response sets a csrf_token cookie, every subsequent same-origin authenticated PUT/POST/DELETE without the header passes. Mitigation: replace the elif with `if not csrf_header: return 403` whenever session_token cookie is present and path is not exempt; only validate match if header is provided. Reproduction: login -> copy session cookies -> PUT /api/profile with NO X-CSRF-Token header -> observe 200 instead of 403.
